turns.text: Okay, this is gonna sound crazy.
turns.zh: 好吧，这话说出来可能有点疯。

turns.text: But do you ever think that your wife dying might be better than what happened to me?
turns.zh: 但你有没有想过，你老婆死了可能比发生在我身上的事还好？
好吧，那我就能说这个了。
